FADE IN:

INT. VETERAN'S BEDROOM - DAY

We see a small, cluttered bedroom. There's a bed, a dresser, and a few pieces of furniture scattered around. The walls are adorned with old photographs and war memorabilia. We hear the sound of a clock ticking in the background.

We see a WW1 veteran, JIM (60s), lying in bed, looking confused. He's dressed in a worn-out uniform, and his hair is thinning. He's trying to remember something, but his eyes are cloudy.

JIM: (to himself) What was I doing? What was I doing?

He looks around the room, trying to remember. He sees a photograph on the dresser and points to it.

JIM: (excitedly) Ah, yes! The lads! We were at the front lines! I remember the sound of the guns, the smell of the mud...

He starts to get up from bed, but stumbles and falls back down.

JIM: (frustrated) What's going on? What's happening?

He looks around the room again, trying to remember. He sees a book on the nightstand and picks it up.

JIM: (reading) "The Great War... 1914-1918..." Ah, yes! I was there! I fought in the Great War!

He starts to get up again, but this time he makes it to the dresser. He looks at the photographs on the wall.

JIM: (pointing) Ah, yes! The lads! We were at the front lines! I remember the sound of the guns, the smell of the mud...

Suddenly, he looks to his side and sees a man standing there. The man is dressed in a uniform, and he's holding a rifle.

JIM: (startled) Ah! What's going on? Who are you?

The man doesn't respond. He just keeps staring at Jim.

JIM: (confused) What's happening? Why are you looking at me like that?

The man slowly raises his rifle and points it at Jim. Jim sees the rifle and his eyes widen in fear.

JIM: (backing away) Ah! No! No! No!

The man pulls the trigger, and Jim's eyes go wide with fear. He looks down and sees that his brain is falling out of his head.

JIM: (screaming) Ah! No! No! No!

The man doesn't flinch. He just keeps staring at Jim as his brain falls to the floor.

JIM: (screaming) Ah! No! No! No!

The scene fades to black as Jim's screams echo through the room.

FADE OUT.
